response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, o.observstation AS observstation, t.bandusagepct AS bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), st AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_band) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, SUM(cnt) AS telescope_count, SUM(cnt) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(cnt)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage
